text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, Maruzensky is being interviewed
for a
magazine article.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
...Next, let's talk about that signature
racewear of
yours.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, this? Heehee, of course! ♪

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
It's a very popular design among fans.
What's
your own impression of it?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It's my favorite! This outfit brings out
100% of my
charming qualities.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
I see. Is there anything in particular that
you like
about it?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well, let's see... The design, the fit...
There are so
many good parts to choose
from!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
But the best thing is the color—this fiery
red!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I've been attached to this color for a
long time.
That's why Tata's red too. ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Actually, maybe it's the other way
around... I've
always wanted a car just
like Tata, so maybe
that's why I love the
color red.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Tata?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm sorry. I got a bit excited and
forgot to
mention. ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
When I was younger, I was taken to a car
show...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
There was a bright red supercar there,
and it was
so cool, I instantly fell head
over heels!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I vowed to myself then and there that
when I
finally got my own car, it would
definitely be that
one.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
After that, I kept looking at the pictures
in
catalogs, dreaming of the day I could
get my
driver's license.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Now that dream has come true, and I'm
all smiles
when I get a chance to hit the
streets! ♪

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
So, you still have the same deep feelings
for this
car that you did back then?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
That's right. And that's why I hope I can
cheer up
the audience with my running,
just like how Tata
cheers me up.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I want to give everyone the same
fabulous feeling
of a hot rod! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The interview proceeds very well.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Now, can we take
a few
pictures?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Okey dokey, artichokey! I'll show off my
best
looks!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Of all the people I know, you
must
know me best, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Of all the people I know, you must
know me
best, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: What should I show off in today's shoot?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I see... I shine the most when I'm
enjoying myself
during a run, right?

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
What should we do? Can we use the
racetrack?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we go right now? You
reporters can
ride with us and enjoy the
speed! ♪

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Erm, do you mean to say you'll be
driving us?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Woo-hoo! I just can't get enough of
Tata's speed!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Um, isn't this a bit too fast?! Ah! Ahh!
AHHHHHH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her expression as she drives at top
speed with the
cowering reporters in tow
really is the brightest...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
My smile? Well, like I always say, the
most
important part is having fun.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
No doubt! I'll give you a smile that'll
knock your
socks off!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
No doubt! I'll give you a smile that'll
knock your
socks off!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It's me, the one and only Hot Rod! Cheeeese! ♪

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: I love it! What a great expression!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later, Maruzensky and I check out the
article.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
This picture really makes my smile look
radiant!
I'm not half bad, if I do say so
myself! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look here! They mentioned you,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look here! They mentioned you,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It says my beautiful smile must be due to
the
trusting relationship I have with my
trainer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Don't be so modest. The reason I smile
so much is
because you support me! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Don't be so modest. The reason I smile
so much is
because you support me! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky's smile now is just as
dazzling as the
one in the picture.
